verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents an Audit Logs product for emitting and exporting events as a compliance and security paper trail. Its pricing lists log streaming per SIEM connection, which covers the core of capturing activity and getting it into a SIEM. The tamper-evident element is not evidenced, and events appear to be emitted by your own application rather than captured automatically from WorkOS authentication and admin activity. Missing for 10: any evidence of tamper-evidence or integrity guarantees, documented automatic capture of authentication and admin events, details of SIEM destinations and streaming setup, and independent hands-on corroboration.
